g.text: How the two outputs enter the ranker
PART III · ESU SIDE: RES-KMEANSFSQ SEMANTIC IDS
For a target item, keep the k history items
with the highest inner product ⟨mᵢ, m⟩.
Retrieval is now semantic, not ID-based:
new items find related history from day one.
Each item = ItemID + three SIDs, each looked
up in its own trainable embedding table.
Multi-task BCE; SID embeddings learned end-to-end.
